description: Source code for LVCS (Concert Sound) processing functions, including LVCS_Process_CS and LVCS_Process, handling stereo enhancement, reverb, equalization, and volume correction.

methods.name: LVCS_Process_CS
methods.description: Processes stereo sound with enhancement, reverb, equalization, and bypass mixing, handling in-place and out-of-place processing.

methods.name: LVCS_Process
methods.description: Main processing function for the Concert Sound module, supporting different algorithms for headphones and mobile speakers, including volume correction and mode transitions.
